title: GLUE: a bus compressor for the whole mix after the SSL G-series centre-section compressor
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: A master page (FUNC + LFO) that runs the whole mix through a stereo-linked bus compressor modelled on the SSL G-series console's centre-section compressor, on every output (main, headphones, USB). THR -40 to 0 dB; RAT 2, 4 or 10; ATK .1 .3 1 3 10 30 ms and REL .1 .3 .6 1.2 s or AUTO, as on the G; make-up gain to +15 dB; MIX for parallel compression; SCF, a high pass on what it listens to (OFF, 60, 90, 150 Hz) so the kick doesn't pump the mix; and the IN / OUT switch. The page has a moving-needle gain reduction meter like the G's and the compression curve with a dot where the mix is right now. Saved. Not made or endorsed by Solid State Logic.
